title: Genomic DNA Extraction
author: Likhith Chandragiri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxeupjew

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge an overnight E. coli culture at 4 °C, 7000 rpm for 10 minutes to obtain a cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in water
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet in 500 µL autoclaved MilliQ water using a pipette and transfer to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube in a laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Add SDS and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL SDS and 3 µL proteinase K (or the volume required for a final concentration of 100 µg/mL).

steps.title: Heat to inactivate proteinase K
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 95 °C for 5 minutes to inactivate proteinase K.

steps.title: Add RNase A and incubate
steps.instruction: Allow the tube to cool to room temperature, add 5 µL RNase A (or the volume needed for 200 µg/mL), and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL phenol‑chloroform mixture, then centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, 4 °C for 10 minutes; the tube will separate into an aqueous top layer, a jelly‑like middle layer, and a chloroform bottom layer.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Using a cut tip, transfer the aqueous layer and the jelly‑like layer to a fresh microcentrifuge tube, add 1 mL phenol‑chloroform mixture, and centrifuge again at 10 000 rpm, 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect aqueous layer and add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Transfer only the top aqueous layer to a fresh tube, add 160 µL of 3 M sodium acetate, and mix gently.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL isopropanol, invert gently until white DNA strands appear, then centrifuge at 5 000 rpm, 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 1 mL chilled 70 % ethanol along the tube walls without disturbing the pellet, and centrifuge at 5 000 rpm, 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Air‑dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the tube until no ethanol remains.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA and store
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 100 µL autoclaved MilliQ water by pipetting, then store the suspension at –30 °C.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Load 1 µL autoclaved MilliQ water as a blank on a NanoDrop, then load 1 µL of the gDNA suspension as the sample to measure concentration.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.5 g agarose in 50 mL TAE buffer, add 2 µL ethidium bromide, and melt to make a 1 % agarose gel.

steps.title: Run DNA on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Load 3 µL 1 kb DNA ladder into lane 1, load 1 µL gDNA plus 1 µL loading dye into lane 2, run the gel, and look for a single band above the ladder’s first band, close to the well.
